user_story: As a guest, I want to create a booking with a very long guest name so that the system handles long string inputs gracefully.

positive.title: Create booking with a long guest name
steps: Navigate to the booking page.
Enter a guest name with 255 characters.
Fill in other required booking details.
Submit the booking form.
positive.expected_result: The booking is created successfully and the long guest name is displayed correctly.

positive.title: Create booking with maximum allowed characters for guest name
steps: Navigate to the booking page.
Enter a guest name with the maximum allowed character limit (if defined).
Fill in other required booking details.
Submit the booking form.
positive.expected_result: The booking is created successfully without any errors.

negative.title: Create booking with guest name exceeding character limit
steps: Navigate to the booking page.
Enter a guest name exceeding the maximum character limit.
Fill in other required booking details.
Submit the booking form.
negative.expected_result: The booking submission fails with an error message indicating the guest name exceeds the allowed character limit.

negative.title: Create booking with empty guest name field
steps: Navigate to the booking page.
Leave the guest name field empty.
Fill in other required booking details.
Submit the booking form.
negative.expected_result: The booking submission fails with an error message indicating that the guest name is required.

edge.title: Create booking with guest name containing special characters
steps: Navigate to the booking page.
Enter a guest name with special characters (e.g., !@#$%^&*()).
Fill in other required booking details.
Submit the booking form.
edge.expected_result: The booking is created successfully, and the system handles special characters in the guest name gracefully.

edge.title: Create booking with guest name of zero length (just spaces)
steps: Navigate to the booking page.
Enter a guest name consisting only of spaces.
Fill in other required booking details.
Submit the booking form.
edge.expected_result: The booking submission fails with an error message indicating that the guest name cannot be blank.
